Trump highlights Vance and Rubio amid 2028 presidential race speculation

Former U.S. President Donald Trump publicly praised Senators JD Vance and Marco Rubio, keeping them in the spotlight as speculation about the 2028 Republican presidential primary continues. Trump stated that both Vance and Rubio are "doing fantastically." This display has led to questions about whether the event served as an audition for potential future presidential candidacies.
